from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric found in a company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report this item belongs to")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the financial item as written in the report (e.g., '一年内到期的非流动负债')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., '元', 'CNY')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the report (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance indicated, e.g., '期末余额', '期初余额'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
